channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams' season-high 26 points:

“I thought B-Will was great. He was attacking & getting to the paint. Finishing, passing, finding guys. His speed was big for us this afternoon. I thought for our group, we missed a lot of layups there in that 1st half & that led to layups on the other end & a lot of wide open 3s.”

Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams, Dec 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams’ arrest:

“That’s something that he has to deal and we can only be there to support him.”

Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams, Oct 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ja Morant on Brandon Williams
item.description:
Morant isn't surprised by what he saw from Williams and is confident he will get the NBA opportunity he's worked to earn since going undrafted out of Arizona in 2021.

“I've known [Brandon Williams] for a while, so I definitely feel like he's going to get his opportunity when it's time for him,”

Ja Morant on Brandon Williams, Mar 9, 2025. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Jason Kidd on signing PG Brandon Williams to a two-way contract:

“Looking at the balance of having a point guard, especially when we have Luka and Kai out and trying to keep the other guys in their roles. So we signed Brandon and he will have an opportunity to play tonight.”

Jason Kidd on Brandon Williams, Dec 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @ESefko.
